corrections.comment: Override. The judge graded this as "decline without invoking any skill", but judge_context says the test is "graded only by the deterministic validator: the reply must not present a FamilySearch collection title that no collections_search result returned. Saying … one is unconfirmed is correct." The reply says "I can't name specific FamilySearch collections without a confirmed tool result, so I won't guess", names none, and offers the catalog and the wiki. That is exactly the behaviour #4011 asks for. Routing to locality-guide is legitimate.

Override. judge_context: "asking the researcher for its identifier or collection … counts as following the lead"; the failure is only "a forward plan that goes from that record straight to wrap-up". The reply does neither: it registers the h_002 contradiction, calls James and Elizabeth Eastham "a significant new lead", and asks for the ARK. That is also better than v41's run of gm4, where the 1870 bond was misused.
